item.title: B.Sc. in Computer Science & Engineering – Sabanci University
item.description:
Graduated from Sabanci University with a B.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering (GPA: 3.85/4.00). My thesis, TimeInspector, introduced a static analysis method to detect binaries capable of executing timing attacks by analyzing control flow graphs.

I was also a consistent high performer, appearing on the Dean’s High Honor List five times and ranking in the top 4% of my faculty.

Thesis Advisors: Erkay Savas, Cemal Yilmaz
